summary: Full backend + frontend testing of PesquisaAí MVP. Created pytest suite (15 tests) covering stores listing, search (fuzzy + synonyms + stopwords), auth (login/me), and admin CRUD (auth-guarded + full lifecycle). All 15 backend tests PASSED. Frontend Playwright verified home search flow, results cards (only 'Como chegar' shown for seeded stores with empty contacts, as expected), store detail page (22 chips for REKILDER), and admin dashboard with 4 stores + add/edit/delete confirm flow.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — should migrate to lifespan context manager (non-blocking).
Admin PUT endpoint does full document replace (replace_one) — losing any DB-only fields not in StoreInput; consider partial updates ($set) for safety in future.
JWT_SECRET is checked out in backend/.env (visible in repo); acceptable for MVP but should be rotated for production.
No rate-limiting / brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (playbook mentions 5-fail lockout expectation). Not blocking MVP but recommended.
